profile_text.body:
Serve Robotics Inc. /DE/ is a public company based in San Carlos, California, and trades under the ticker SERV. Its website presents it as a maker of self-driving delivery robots aimed at the last-mile problem, framed around the question of why a two-pound burrito should move in a two-ton car. The company describes its robots as a low-emissions alternative for local delivery and says it is setting a standard for safety on and beyond the sidewalk, including protection of customer data, employees, and the public. It also describes itself as a pop culture icon, noting that its robot Saymo appeared alongside John Mulaney on the show "Everybody's Live."

The company's registration records give it CIK 0001832483, and its incorporation is indicated as Delaware in its registered name. No specific products are listed in the material available, and no individual lawsuits are named.

Its recorded litigation exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
